title: Formalize the conditional common-label tensor lift
body:
PR2287's selected complex layer uses a common-label argument to lift one-column unary recipes to every finite column count. This independently formalizes that specific implication on the unchanged `LemmaG.Stream` semantics. It tensors unary labels and recipes while retaining each role coefficient once, and covers arbitrary correlated arrays and dirty roles, including COPY/CLEAR.

The main theorem makes the coefficient-field embedding explicit: rational role scalars may map into ℂ while the address tensor is taken over ℂ. A unit scalar-shadow row gives an uncontaminated unary output. The finite-coordinate tensor equivalence covers the full array space. Kernel-checked counterexamples show why a bare one-column endpoint, tensoring role signs, or tensoring a sum-of-operators equality cannot replace the hypotheses.

Start with `research/lean-common-label-tensor-lift/README.md` and `lean/TensorLift.lean`. The generic replay is:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/lean-common-label-tensor-lift
```

That command explicitly reports source/finite checks only. The README gives the separate fresh Lean build command, also wired into a dedicated workflow. Local evidence:

- Lean 4.33.0-rc1 / pinned Mathlib: all 21 theorem targets built; only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound` in their axiom reports. Three deliberately false claims failed on their mathematical goals. Actual source-bound receipt: `KERNEL.json`.
- Exact Q(i) replay at widths 0–4: 124 basis inputs, 20 dense inputs, 100 prefixes, and 11 shortcut controls, with independently constructed endpoint matrices.
- Registered Python 3.12.3 optimized replay and eight verifier-control groups passed; Git-free read-only Python 3.14.4 replay passed with all 22 exported files unchanged.

This is a conditional semantic bridge, not a formalization of the complete selected supplier or outer multiplication theorem. It does not prove the actual R480 native recipe implementation meets the hypotheses, rerun the full selected payload, certify hosting, recursive rows/tapes or precision, or change κ. The README/TASK provide concrete source-importer and physical-interpreter handoffs.

Source audit: PR2287 head `8c60765b5dea9d862b3b190d55da102a576031bf`, sections 2/4. Canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, and the predecessor head were rechecked before submission. The final live text refresh covered 551 open PRs and 1,063 Discussion records (complete pagination, no warnings; PR 05:55:24 UTC / Discussion 05:56:57 UTC). It does not search arbitrary code diffs. The independent-audit claim is in [Discussion2253](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2253#discussioncomment-18941667).

Gareth Davidson (`bitplane`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no sub-agents or independent human review. Credit remains with Jose Manuel for PR2287's written argument; DreamingOfClouds and the retained Lemma G contributor lineage for its semantics/proof; and Mathlib for tensor infrastructure. The verifier harness adapts our PR2295. Source notices and Apache-2.0 license are retained.
